description: Number of data-center records the Atlas of Data Center Politics lists for each of the 242 countries and territories of abf-boundaries, split by status and by size class. A record is counted under the country the Atlas lists it under, not by its point. 0 means that the Atlas lists no data-center record for the country; it does not mean that the country has no data centers. groups.csv gives the same counts for groups of countries (EU27).

coverage.geography: All 242 countries and territories of abf-boundaries v0.2.0
known_gaps: The Atlas states that absence from it should not be read as evidence that a facility does not exist, and that its coverage is broad but uneven. 116 countries and territories have 0 records because the Atlas lists none for them.

Counts follow the Atlas rows: records identical in every field are counted separately, and a record is counted under the country the Atlas lists it under, also where its point falls in a neighboring country.

The one record the Atlas lists under Somaliland is counted under Somalia (SOM), because abf-boundaries has no separate unit for Somaliland. This follows the boundary frame and is not a position on its status.
The Atlas gives Gibraltar as a first-level unit; its one record is counted under GIB, a unit of abf-boundaries.
The record in Simferopol, Crimea, is counted under Russia, as the Atlas lists it; abf-boundaries v0.2.0 shows Crimea under Russian control and records Ukraine's claim (contested_areas).

verification.method: Records are counted by script by the country under which the Atlas lists them. The build stops if the counts of the 242 units do not add up to the 9,865 records of the point layer. That the Atlas lists 126 countries and territories was read by V on the Atlas site on 18 October 2026; V also checked that Malta and Libya, which are not in the list, have no records, and that Portugal has no Retired records (manual_checks.csv).

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
The file has exactly one row for each of the 242 countries and territories of the boundaries release; 242 are covered and 0 are not_covered with empty values.
Every unit_id of the layer exists in the boundaries release and no unit_id is repeated.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
The sum of every numeric column read back from the published CSV equals the sum in the input table.
No field of the layer, of its files or of its tiles carries a power, capacity, generator or load value.

Recomputed from the published file and equal to the numbers in the texts of this layer: the number of records (242); the counts by coverage_status; the totals of n_records; the number of zero values of n_records.
